message: おかえり
--April.
The season of fluttering cherry blossoms had arrived.
Even after graduating, Ria-senpai still stopped by to visit quite often.
The Student Council was as swamped as ever--though I suppose that couldn't be helped with the secretary seat still vacant.
Today, under the guise of a rehearsal for the new student welcome party, we had claimed a spot in the plaza beneath the full-bloom cherry trees for a flower-viewing party.
Well, the rehearsal was just an excuse; truth be told, we all just wanted to cut loose and have a blast together.
Even at an event meant to be this lively and fun, I still couldn't help feeling a touch of loneliness.
Yet every time I did, I would look at my ring and remember.
--Alright! Time to throw myself into today's Student Council duties with full energy!

name: Misa
message: 「Heyy!! Why is there alcohol set out here!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, that must've been my big sister.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, since she went through the trouble of bringing it for us, let's drink up, drink up!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... Admittedly, breaking out the booze is one surefire way to liven things up, though--」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, no, no! Student Council officers can't be doing stuff like that!」

name: Synn
message: 「T-This sound...」
「Good grief, you're all so hopeless~~」
A voice brimming with confidence, despite having no basis for it whatsoever.
「Hmm, hmm... So this is what they call cherry-blossom viewing...」
And a boundless sense of adventure, endlessly curious about everything.
「Aaaah! Look at all these sweets laid out here!!」
Notorious for being a total glutton with a massive weak spot for delicious food.
「And there's even alcohol... Thump-thump... This feels super dangerous~~!」
Knowing full well she shouldn't do bad things, yet inevitably giving in to temptation anyway.
It was almost as if the girl I loved most in the world was standing right there--

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe, I came back again!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Everyone, I'm home♪」

name: Everyone
message: 「Welcome back!」

name: Synn
message: 「Welcome back!」
An angel had once again descended upon Ryuusei Academy.
